summary: Comprehensive testing of AI Lecture Companion mobile app. Backend: 12/12 tests passed (100%). Frontend: All core flows working - home screen, record screen, notes view, processing screen, navigation. Minor design issue with delete button touch target size.

issues: Delete button touch target is 26x28 pixels (below minimum 44x44 for mobile). Has hitSlop prop which helps, but visual target should be larger for better UX.
Shadow* style props deprecated warning - should migrate to boxShadow (non-critical, works but shows deprecation warning)

react_native_issues.issue: React Native Alert.alert doesn't render as web dialog in Expo web preview - this is expected behavior. Delete functionality is correctly implemented and will work on real mobile devices.

action_items: Consider increasing delete button visual size or adding a larger touch area wrapper (currently 26x28, should be 44x44 minimum)
Optional: Migrate shadow* props to boxShadow to remove deprecation warnings
Optional: Update Expo package versions from canary to stable (expo-audio, expo-file-system, expo-print, expo-sharing)
